dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If I know you, you won't stop until you've plumbed the depths of this domain and uncovered every secret it hides.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, I have nothing but admiration for the people who see things through to the end, whatever path they're on.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But you never know what price you'll have to pay to reach your destination. The unfortunate reality is, it's up to the whims of fate.
